_: Meta keys the accounting app (sthesabland: src/lib/woo/describe.ts cardMeta, CARD_CONTRACT_VERSION) writes on every phone product, and stland-home reads: 'keys' for card badges (stlh_defaults card_badges), 'spec' for the one-line spec under the name (stlh_spec_line). Bump 'version' and STLH_CONTRACT together; the accounting health panel compares it with the site's /wp-json/stland/v1/status. 'seo' (v3): SEO title/description/focus keyword that includes/seo-bridge.php copies into Yoast's _yoast_wpseo_* fields. 'product' (v4): stl_health — JSON of the used phone's health booklet ({items:[{l,v,ok}],total,checked,battery,cycles}) that includes/product-page.php renders under the warning box; empty string = no booklet. 'keys' (v5): real_photo = '1' when the phone's own photos are shown (card badge «عکس واقعی»); empty = no badge. 'sale' (v6): sale_show = 'percent' | 'amount' — how the discount pill shows for this product (Novo: the owner set the discount as a percent or as a toman price); empty = the site-wide «تایمرِ تخفیف» choice (stlh_sale_display). 'inquiry' (v7): stl_inquiry = '1' when the product is consignment (امانی) and needs a stock inquiry before purchase — includes/inquiry.php makes it non-purchasable, shows «استعلام موجودی» (WhatsApp/call) instead of add-to-cart and a card badge; '' or missing = direct purchase. Novo always sends it so turning it off also arrives.
